rules: Outbound links only to verified URLs (this file). Never invent per-text deep links.
Witness text never hosted, never in site data; grounds cite, quotes <=25 words.
Our glosses are ours; witnesses are signals with source tags, never ground truth.
Upstream fixes (typos in GRETIL etc.) go upstream via their channels; we record edition + line, never silently emend.
